newsitem.title: USA: Air Force halts merger of two companies - report.
newsitem.headline: Air Force halts merger of two companies - report.

text.p: The U.S. Air Force is blocking Science Applications International Corp.'s plan to buy Aerospace Corp. because the merger could disrupt the nation's spy satellite program, the Washington Post reported on Saturday.
SAIC proposed buying the non-profit enterprise, which has worked closely with the Air Force for 36 years as a virtual wing of its classified space program, and turning it into a for-profit operation.

But Lockheed Martin Corp. and TRW Inc. raised concerns about the merger, saying they felt uncomfortable competing with a company that has had unrestricted access to their space operations and space plans.
The Air Force said its review of the merger "concluded that the proposed merger would negatively impact the trusted agent role (Aerospace) had served for more than 36 years," the Post reported.
